title: A gate launched soon after a new worktree's checkout is refused credit for the checkout's own file writes
outcome: Files written by `git worktree add` before a root is named, or before the launch turn, never count as a change "while it was being launched". A gate launched in the first turn after naming a freshly checked-out worktree is credited when nothing wrote the tree afterwards.
acceptance: Diagnose, with source locators, why the host attributed ui\src\transcript-proof-boundary.test.ts (written at 03:17:42Z by the checkout) to gate test launched at 03:18:29.115Z, e.g. delayed watcher events from the checkout delivered after the naming took effect.
A test or drill creates a worktree, names it, launches a recognized run in the next turn and shows it credited, while a genuine write during the launch is still refused.
The refusal text, when it rightly applies, names the file and the time of the write it saw.
